scope: online signal distribution on 11 unused calibration prompts; no held-out policies or quality claim
signal_context: decoded prior coarse trajectory before each target segment

threshold_fit_after_audit.rule: For target fraction b, take the linear empirical quantile at 1-b of the 44 direction-oriented online coarse-context scores; select fine when score >= threshold. Fit only after all 11 calibration cases pass the local audit.

limitations: coarse-context scores may shift once fine modes are selected
pilot prompt 6 is excluded from threshold fitting because its scores were already inspected
no residual probe, reference video, independent quality endpoint, or held-out result
